Priya: quick proposal 1 — narrow the Optimize delivery for next sprint: deliver eval-triggered alerting MVP + rule-based quantization advice. Push adaptive batching and cache-eviction heuristics to the following sprint. opinions? :seedling:

Noah: sounds pragmatic. We can fairly quickly wire eval->alert pipeline. Two asks: clear firing rules + a dedupe/noise strategy. Also need minimal Console controls to opt a customer into canary.

Priya: propose ACs (please edit):
- Alerting latency: alerts produced within 60s after eval-run completion.
- Firing rules: configurable per-org/per-model thresholds for any monitored metric (precision, recall, f1, rouge).
- Payload: include model id, model version, eval run id, metric deltas, top 5 failing example IDs with short diffs, and link to eval report.
- Noise controls: per-org dedupe window (default 10m), and per-run rate-limit (default 3 alerts/run).
- Retention: raw alert events 180d, aggregated metrics 365d.
- Canary: single-customer opt-in with CS notification before enablement.

Arman: on quantization recs (MVP): use deterministic rules: recommend INT8 if measured p99 latency improves >=12% and eval-concordance drop <=1.5%. Recommendation should include estimated throughput uplift, expected token-cost change, and a short risk summary (sample failure modes). Keep recommendations advisory (no auto-apply).

Casey: EdgeHealth (pilot customer) confirmed canary interest but requests an email webhook to CS and a preflight dry-run mode so they can preview failing examples without alerting users.

Noah: infra notes: need event schema + index plan for top failing ids. Suggest adding an "alert_summary" index for quick queries and an ops playbook with rollback steps. Will implement feature-flag gated endpoints only for canary orgs.

Priya: ok plan of record:
- Ship: eval-triggered alerts (MVP) + rule-based quant recs (advisory)
- Defer: adaptive batching, cache-eviction heuristics to sprint+1
- Rollout: feature-flag gated canary (EdgeHealth) with CS pre-notify and dry-run option

Quick API example to create alert config:
```
POST /api/v1/optimize/alerts
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
{
  "org_id": "edgehealth",
  "model_id": "redwood-7b-v2",
  "metric": "f1",
  "threshold": -0.02,    // alert if drop >= 2%
  "dedupe_minutes": 10,
  "notify_webhook": "https://hooks.example.com/cs-alerts",
  "dry_run": true
}
```

infra-bot: feature-flag created: optimize_eval_mvp (id: ff-2026) :white_check_mark:

Noah: I'll scope a minimal telemetry pipeline and the alert index changes; target: minimal end-to-end for canary in 2 sprints.

Priya: I'll update the roadmap board, add tickets with the ACs, and coordinate CS onboarding with Casey. Thanks! :raised_hands:
